english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a state of ambiguity or wording that permits more than one interpretation.

examples.english: There is ambiguity in this sentence, so you have to check the context to know what it means.
examples.traditional: 呢句說話有歧義，要睇上下文先知佢想表達乜。
